name: Fireworks
summary: Inference cloud aimed at production traffic: fast open-model serving, structured output and accountable rate limits.
description:
Fireworks competes on the parts a business cares about — throughput under load, function calling and JSON output that actually validates, model coverage that includes the current open releases, and an enterprise story built around predictable limits instead of best-effort shared capacity. It is where teams land when a hobby endpoint stops surviving their own traffic.

Fine-tuning and dedicated deployments push you into a procurement conversation about GPUs and commitments, at which point self-hosting with vLLM becomes a live alternative worth pricing honestly. Speed claims should be verified against your prompt shape, since prefill-heavy workloads behave nothing like benchmark tweets.
